newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures slip ahead of spot expiry.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures slip ahead of spot expiry.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower across the board on Monday as concern over the spot expiry on Tuesday stimulated private investors' selling, particularly in nearby months, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.5 yen to 3.1 yen per kg lower. The benchmark August contract was off 0.9 yen at 152.0 yen.

Trading was sluggish. "There is a concern that market players could be wary of taking deliveries at the spot expiry at the current price level," an analyst at a commodity broker said. The yen's firmer trend against the dollar also dampened market sentiment, the traders said.
